absent.note: A certificate that will expire in 60 days is a plan, not an error.
Certificate errors and clock drift are only described as what would happen if a node missed the rollover.
A checklist is promised, not yet sent.

annotations.rationale: No failure exists: this is advance planning for a certificate rollover and a clock-source change. Certificate and clock-skew words appear as an upcoming expiry and as conditionals, so they are not signals. The only action in the vocabulary is the node-check checklist the engineer sends in ev04, a request to review certificates, clocks and logs on each node.
